data.body:
Landed. Gerrit change 1652 merged to main as 78257ce2ff, with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1
(full CI matrix green, including the ubuntu py3.12 leg where the flake was originally observed).

All acceptance criteria verified before close:
AC1 - clone B's base is now established by _sync_from_origin(): checked git fetch origin tickets
      + git merge --ff-only FETCH_HEAD. No _engine_run(repo_b, 'list') / _expire_sync_marker in
      the helper's convergence path.
AC2 - both preconditions assert with 'SETUP (not the I1 invariant)' plus set-difference detail,
      textually distinct from the I1 append-only messages.
AC3 - under REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off all three *_sidecar_emit_two_clone_union tests pass on the fixed
      code; the same command fails all three on pre-fix code with the reported signature.
AC4 - all 29 tests in the file pass under the default environment; no wall-clock or timing-budget
      assertion added (a grep for time/elapsed/sleep patterns over the file is clean).
AC5 - make lint and make typecheck pass.

Diff is test-only: tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py, +31/-4. No production code
changed, so the sidecar emit behaviour under test is unchanged and still fully exercised.
Closing as flaky - this was a harness defect, not a product defect.
